sourceAttempts.result: BLM rates the Bosque Class II, documents 6.5 miles to Embudo Station and names County Line, BLM Beach and Embudo Station as designated sites. It warns of private land, a quiet zone, designated access requirements and bridge hazards above 6,000 cfs.
Documents the County Line to Embudo Station 6.5-mile reach, a 300 cfs minimum planning cue and public access below the Embudo gauging bridge.
USGS 08279500 at Embudo is a direct Rio Grande discharge station and is used for downstream telemetry.

Embudo Station restaurant is reserved for patrons and Lovers Lane/Embudo South are not treated as verified public endpoints; both routes use only County Line or Quartzite and the documented public gauging-station access.

thresholdEvidence.reachApplicability: The 300 cfs cue is a Bosque planning minimum from a reach-specific paddling description; verify live gauge, trend, weather and channel conditions before launch.

validation: Focused Bosque Rio Grande route safety test passed.
Typecheck, route audit, safety audit, gallery audit and geometry generation/audit passed after integration.
